name: Roboto Origin
summary: Roboto Origin is RoboParty’s open-source bipedal humanoid platform for education, research and development. The manufacturer documents a body approximately 1.25 metres tall with 23 degrees of freedom, alongside structural, electrical, training and deployment materials. It is designed for users who want to assemble and work with a complete humanoid system. The listing describes the published prototype platform; current commercial delivery availability is unverified.
